WF-04 Workflow

  • Xoá activity “Follow the method and measure in the booking”
  • Đổi đầu cạnh: ● initial node “Booked test starts (WF-03 Testing assignment and scheduling); sample folders bound in Medilab Sync (SF-11 Laboratory file administration)” → activity “Follow the method and measure in the booking” → ● initial node “Booked test starts (WF-03 Testing assignment and scheduling); sample folders bound in Medilab Sync (SF-11 Laboratory file administration)” → system activity “Start booking; mark machine busy”
  • Đổi đầu cạnh: notification “✉ Notify tester” → activity “Follow the method and measure in the booking” [retest with a new booking] → notification “✉ Notify tester” → system activity “Start booking; mark machine busy” [retest with a new booking]
  • Đổi đầu cạnh: activity “Follow the method and measure in the booking” → decision “Testing produces files?” → system activity “Start booking; mark machine busy” → decision “Testing produces files?”
  • Đổi đầu cạnh: system activity “Close testing task” → notification “✉ Notify head” → system activity “Close testing task” → system activity “Mark machine available”
  • Thêm system activity “Mark machine available” → notification “✉ Notify head”
  • Thêm system activity “Start booking; mark machine busy”
  • Thêm system activity “Mark machine available”
